newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Seven Ukraine miners injured in gas explosion.
newsitem.headline: Seven Ukraine miners injured in gas explosion.

text.p: Seven miners were badly burned in a methane explosion in a mine in Ukraine's eastern Donbass coal region, a local official said on Monday.

Zinaida Kaluger, a duty officer at the Donetsk regional administration, said by telephone that the explosion occurred on Monday in the Tsentralnaya pit in Makeyevka, about 500 km (300 miles) east of Kiev.
"The methane exploded at a level of 450 metres underground and dozen of miners was trapped in the mine -- seven were badly burned," Kaluger said. "Those injured are now in hospital."
Five miners were killed last month and more than 200 died last year in fatal mining accidents across the country.
